text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle trains her hardest for the 
upcoming Mile Championship.

One day, she learned that her close 
friend, Silence Suzuka, would be running 
in the Mile Championship.

Silence Suzuka explains that she is 
challenging various races to find that 
"something" missing from her running.

Taiki Shuttle's spirits soar at the news 
of her rival joining the fray. More fired 
up than ever, she devotes herself to her 
training.
